description: Hand-curated premium player chips for top-importance profiles. Merged into playerEditorialOverlays.json by apply-premium-player-pass.js — fact-locked, no quiz eligibility changes.

haaland.quickFact: His meditation-style goal celebration became one of the Premier League's most recognizable rituals.
haaland.playStyleSummary: Relentless finisher with explosive runs and ruthless positioning in the box.

bellingham.quickFact: Became Birmingham City's youngest-ever first-team player at 16 years and 38 days.
bellingham.playStyleSummary: Complete midfielder who arrives in the box, presses aggressively, and leads with charisma.

salah.quickFact: Worked in a café during a rough patch after Chelsea — before becoming Liverpool's defining goal scorer of a generation.
salah.playStyleSummary: Left-footed inverted winger who cuts inside for curlers and thrives on counterattacks.

vinicius.quickFact: Scored the 2022 Champions League final winner for Real Madrid after rising through Flamengo's youth ranks.
vinicius.playStyleSummary: Direct left winger who beats defenders with pace, draws fouls, and delivers in big games.

kane.quickFact: Won the 2018 World Cup Golden Boot as England captain before leaving Tottenham for Bayern Munich.
kane.playStyleSummary: Nine-and-a-half striker who links play, drops deep, and finishes with both feet and from set pieces.

musiala.quickFact: Chose Germany over England despite growing up in the English youth system — the Bambi nickname stuck at Bayern.
musiala.playStyleSummary: Low-centre dribbler who glides between lines with close control and composure in tight spaces.

modric.quickFact: Won the 2018 Ballon d'Or after leading Croatia to a World Cup final — still orchestrating Madrid at 40.
modric.playStyleSummary: Outside-foot metronome who controls tempo, resists the press, and never stops running.

rodri.quickFact: Scored the 2023 Champions League final winner and became Spain's Euro 2024 midfield anchor.
rodri.playStyleSummary: Screening pivot who recycles possession, breaks lines with progressive passes, and arrives late in the box.

van-dijk.quickFact: Organised Liverpool's 2019 Champions League triumph and captains the Netherlands from centre-back.
van-dijk.playStyleSummary: Commanding aerial defender who reads danger early, wins duels, and distributes calmly.

saka.quickFact: Hale End graduate who became Arsenal's right wing and England's most trusted wide outlet.
saka.playStyleSummary: Inverted right winger who cuts inside to shoot, works defensively, and delivers from wide.

de-bruyne.quickFact: Set the Premier League single-season assists record in 2019–20 — the benchmark for modern playmakers.
de-bruyne.playStyleSummary: Visionary creator who threads through balls, whips crosses, and strikes from distance.

foden.quickFact: Stockport-born City №47 who became a one-club England creator under Pep Guardiola.
foden.playStyleSummary: Both-footed technician who dribbles in tight spaces and finds pockets between defensive lines.

pedri.quickFact: Euro 2020 Young Player of the Tournament — La Masia's press-resistant link for Spain.
pedri.playStyleSummary: Low-centre midfielder who feints past pressure, carries forward, and keeps Spain ticking.

gavi.quickFact: Teenage La Masia firebrand who paired with Pedri to revive Spain's midfield energy.
gavi.playStyleSummary: Aggressive ball-winner who presses relentlessly and adds flair dribbles in transition.

lewandowski.quickFact: Scored five Bundesliga goals in nine minutes for Bayern — Poland's all-time record scorer.
lewandowski.playStyleSummary: Classic centre-forward who times runs perfectly, links play, and finishes with both feet.

lautaro.quickFact: Inter captain and 2022 World Cup co-top scorer — Argentina's bull-celebration striker.
lautaro.playStyleSummary: Pressing forward who links play, runs off the shoulder, and finishes with power.

alisson.quickFact: Scored a 95th-minute header for Liverpool and backstopped Brazil as their long-term №1.
alisson.playStyleSummary: Composed sweeper-keeper who dominates 1v1s, distributes accurately, and commands his area.

rice.quickFact: West Ham captain before Arsenal made him England's midfield shield and set-piece weapon.
rice.playStyleSummary: Defensive anchor who shields the back line, wins duels, and progresses with simple passes.

neuer.quickFact: Reinvented the sweeper-keeper role and lifted the 2014 World Cup as Germany's captain.
neuer.playStyleSummary: Sweeper-keeper who rushes off his line, commands the box, and starts attacks with distribution.

kimmich.quickFact: Converted from full-back to Bayern's midfield general — Germany's tempo-setter and leader.
kimmich.playStyleSummary: Versatile midfielder who tackles, switches play, and organises pressing triggers.

saliba.quickFact: Loan spell at Marseille sharpened him before becoming Arsenal's calm French defensive anchor.
saliba.playStyleSummary: Composed centre-back who wins aerial duels, steps into midfield, and rarely panics.

odegaard.quickFact: Real Madrid prodigy who found his level as Arsenal captain and Norway's creative hub.
odegaard.playStyleSummary: Left-footed playmaker who finds pockets, threads passes, and dictates final-third tempo.

valverde.quickFact: Uruguay's engine at Real Madrid — covers every blade of grass from midfield or wide.
valverde.playStyleSummary: Box-to-box carrier who runs tirelessly, tackles hard, and arrives with late shooting threat.

leao.quickFact: Portuguese left winger whose pace powered AC Milan's 2022 Serie A title.
leao.playStyleSummary: Direct left winger who explodes into space, beats defenders 1v1, and finishes with power.

bastoni.quickFact: Left-sided centre-back in Inter's back three — Italy's modern ball-playing defender.
bastoni.playStyleSummary: Progressive centre-back who steps into midfield, wins duels, and organises a high line.

trent.quickFact: Liverpool academy full-back famous for whipped crosses before joining Real Madrid.
trent.playStyleSummary: Attacking right-back who delivers from wide, inverts into midfield, and creates set-piece danger.

raphinha.quickFact: Brazil winger who became Barcelona's direct outlet after starring at Leeds and Leeds-style intensity.
raphinha.playStyleSummary: Direct wide forward who presses aggressively, cuts inside, and strikes with both feet.

tm-28003.quickFact: Argentina's 2022 World Cup-winning №10 who moved to Inter Miami in 2023.
tm-28003.playStyleSummary: Left-footed creator who drifts inside, threads through-balls, and finishes with placement.

tm-68290.quickFact: Brazil's flair icon who won Olympic gold in 2016 and returned to Santos in this dataset.
tm-68290.playStyleSummary: Skillful forward who draws fouls, creates from deep, and thrives in tight spaces.

tm-91845.quickFact: South Korea captain who left Tottenham for LAFC as Asia's Premier League face.
tm-91845.playStyleSummary: Inverted forward who cuts inside, combines quickly, and finishes with both feet.

tm-288230.quickFact: France's 2018 World Cup winner who starred at Dortmund before PSG and a brief Barça spell.
tm-288230.playStyleSummary: Explosive forward who attacks space at pace, beats defenders 1v1, and finishes clinically.

tm-85288.quickFact: 2010 World Cup winner with Spain's golden generation — flair playmaker now at Betis.
tm-85288.playStyleSummary: Creative midfielder who operates in tight spaces with flair passes and set-piece craft.

tm-502670.quickFact: Georgia's headline winger who broke out at Napoli before joining PSG.
tm-502670.playStyleSummary: Left-footed winger who cuts inside, beats defenders 1v1, and creates from wide.

tm-181767.quickFact: PSG captain and Brazil's defensive anchor — São Paulo youth product in Paris.
tm-181767.playStyleSummary: Commanding centre-back who reads play, leads the line, and distributes from deep.

tm-257814.quickFact: Switzerland's №1 at Dortmund — Stuttgart roots and Yellow Wall heroics.
tm-257814.playStyleSummary: Athletic goalkeeper who sweeps behind a high line and makes reflex saves.

tm-270541.quickFact: Guinea striker who moved from Stuttgart to Dortmund as a Der Klassiker goal threat.
tm-270541.playStyleSummary: Physical centre-forward who holds up play, attacks the box, and finishes with power.

tm-187492.quickFact: Germany's creative №10 at Dortmund after a Leverkusen youth upbringing.
tm-187492.playStyleSummary: Advanced playmaker who finds half-space pockets, delivers through balls, and presses high.

tm-412363.quickFact: Real Madrid winger in Brazil's 2022 World Cup squad — Bernabéu goals from the right.
tm-412363.playStyleSummary: Quick wide forward who combines in tight spaces and finishes with composure.

tm-640428.quickFact: France's 2022 World Cup final midfielder — Rennes academy product now at Real Madrid.
tm-640428.playStyleSummary: Multi-positional carrier who wins duels, recycles possession, and covers ground.

tm-348795.quickFact: Argentina's 2022 World Cup-winning playmaker — creative hub at Betis.
tm-348795.playStyleSummary: Left-footed creator who unlocks defences with through balls and quick combinations.

tm-111873.quickFact: 2022 World Cup Golden Glove winner — Aston Villa keeper and Argentina's penalty hero.
tm-111873.playStyleSummary: Composed shot-stopper who dominates 1v1s and organises the defensive line.

tm-479999.quickFact: Arsenal playmaker and England creator — left-footed final passes from the half-space.
tm-479999.playStyleSummary: Drifting playmaker who receives between lines and slides through balls late.

tm-504215.quickFact: USMNT attacking midfielder in the European pipeline — Dortmund youth product.
tm-504215.playStyleSummary: Technical №10 who links midfield and attack with vision and quick feet.

tm-59016.quickFact: Austria's captain who won trebles with Bayern and Madrid — plays left-back or centre-back with equal composure.
tm-59016.playStyleSummary: Versatile defender who plays left-back or centre-back with composure and long passing.

tm-125781.quickFact: France's 2018 World Cup winner and Atlético Madrid's all-time leading scorer.
tm-125781.playStyleSummary: Intelligent second striker who drops between lines, presses, and creates with subtle passes.

tm-338424.quickFact: Euro 2024 hero for Spain — box-to-box midfielder now at Arsenal.
tm-338424.playStyleSummary: Energetic midfielder who arrives in the box, presses hard, and finishes with headers.
